jdText:
Job Title: Full Stack Developer
Company: Acme Tech Solutions
Location: Hyderabad, India / Remote

About the Role:
We are seeking a proactive Full Stack Developer to build and maintain modern web applications. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design scalable backend architectures and intuitive user interfaces.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop robust, scalable web applications using React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and Express.js.
- Design and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices.
- Work with relational and NoSQL databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Firebase.
- Build responsive, mobile-first UI components with Tailwind CSS and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (JWT, OAuth, role-based access control).
- Manage CI/CD deployment pipelines using Git, GitHub Actions, and cloud services (AWS / Cloudinary / Vercel).
- Integrate AI features, chatbots, or automated workflows using modern LLM APIs where relevant.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Proven experience with React, Node.js, Express, and REST APIs.
- Hands-on experience with database querying, schema design, and ORMs.
- Familiarity with version control (Git) and API testing tools like Postman.
- Experience with AI APIs, prompt engineering, or automation workflows is a strong plus.
